# LangQuant

> Language State Compression and the Linguistically Persistent Cognitive Interface (LPCI).

langquant is a scaffold-as-state research artifact testing whether a refreshing language scaffold can serve as the sole working state for a stateless LLM. The implementation sends the main model only a typed scaffold and the current user message; the UI transcript is stored separately and is not included in that request. A smaller local model refreshes the inspectable state after each turn.

Current evidence boundary:
- Directly verified: no-transcript main-model payload; typed, refreshed, inspectable state
- Exploratory only: 74 completed 20-turn continuity sessions and a 40-row A/B trace
- The reported continuity scores do not use one shared ground-truth evaluator across conditions
- Historical transfer-entropy outputs are invalid for claim use; see docs/EXPERIMENTS.md
- Continuity runs used qwen3.5:9b (main) + qwen3.5:4b (state extractor)

Stack: Python 3.11+, Ollama (local), pyitlib + scipy for information-theoretic analysis.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): Architecture, quick start, current evidence boundary
- [Experiment record](docs/EXPERIMENTS.md): Methods, result provenance, scorer and estimator limitations
- [LOG](LOG.md): Complete development log with experiment details
- [TODO](TODO.md): Future work and practical applications roadmap

## Code
- [lpci.py](lpci.py): Core prototype — SessionState, LPCISession, state extraction, scaffold refresh, interactive CLI
- [lpci_test.py](lpci_test.py): A/B continuity test — 20 turns × 2 conditions, probes, scaffold evaluation, delta tracing
- [analyze_results.py](analyze_results.py): Information-theoretic analysis — MI, KL divergence, transfer entropy
- [run_experiment.py](run_experiment.py): Single-shot scaffold amplification harness (4 models × 5 conditions × 12 tasks × 3 runs)

## Data
- [results/lpci_ab_test.jsonl](results/lpci_ab_test.jsonl): Exploratory A/B trace (40 rows)
- [results/lpci_rigorous_summary.jsonl](results/lpci_rigorous_summary.jsonl): Continuity session summaries (74 rows; historical TE field is non-citable)
- [results/full_run_v1.jsonl](results/full_run_v1.jsonl): Scaffold-amplification matrix (720 rows)
- [tasks/task_set.jsonl](tasks/task_set.jsonl): Task definitions
